messages:
jordan: Heads up — this week's release train is shifted 6 hours earlier due to infra maintenance in us-west. Release freeze window starts 2025-10-09T02:00Z -> 2025-10-10T06:00Z. Please hold any non-critical deploys. :rotating_light:

nina: Thanks — is the canary still on for v3.7.2 or do we pause it during the freeze?

jordan: Canary continues but with reduced traffic (10% -> 3%). If canary fails we'll abort and fallback to v3.7.1. See rollback window below.

leo: Quick q — what about scheduled auto-rollouts from the pipeline? Should they be bumped?

jordan: Yes, bump any scheduled auto-rollouts to after the embargo ends or put them in manual. I'll update the release calendar.

sam: FYI, perf team will run a latency sweep at 03:30Z during the freeze. We'll tag any regressions in #eng-sre.

release-bot: Deploy status: canary/v3.7.2 -> 3 hosts, throughput 80r/s, errors 0.4% (expected <0.5%).

nina: Can you paste the rollback command? want it handy.

jordan: rollback script:
```
./deploy rollback --service=api-gateway --to=v3.7.1 --reason='canary-fail'
```

leo: Noted. I'll also add a temporary routing policy to prefer eu regions for low-latency customers.

sam: If anyone needs exception to freeze, ping me + Jordan and include risk matrix. We'll triage.

jordan: Thanks — quick checklist for teams: 1) freeze declared, 2) canary reduced, 3) rollback cmd noted, 4) exceptions must have approvers. Reply here if you have blockers. :thumbsup:
